rationale: Review started 2026-11-10T06:54:52Z and ended 2026-11-10T07:05:36Z (UTC). I re-hashed jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11816.txt and EO_12163.txt (both match, as do all source fingerprints), confirmed the spans, and read EO 11816 (39 FR 37965, signed October 23, 1974) in full, confirming identity: its only content restates section 301(a) of Part III of EO 10973 to delegate the section 514(a)(2) and (b), second-sentence 612(a) and 634(f) and (g) functions to the Secretary of the Treasury, with no own-terms end. EO 11959 Sec. 6 (January 1977) later restated the whole of section 301, an earlier rewrite that under the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling continues the clause, amended, until the parent ends; it does not change the status. EO 12163 Sec. 1-903(a)(1) (signed September 29, 1979) revokes 'Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended', which reaches EO 11816's amendment, and Sec. 1-905 makes the order effective as of October 1, 1979; the Sec. 1-904 savings clause applies only 'except to the extent inconsistent with this order', and EO 12163 itself re-delegates these functions (Sec. 1-501 to Treasury, Sec. 1-102 all other Act functions to the IDCA Director), so it does not keep EO 11816's text in force. A cruden number search found no other held text citing EO 11816, the U.S. Code and eCFR searches had 0 hits, and I found no revival of EO 10973. The recommended status NO, ended effective October 1, 1979, is supported by held sources through 2026-10-14.
